text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory!!! I look forward to working 
with you todaaay!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Such impressive fighting spirit. Her 
condition is splendid as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno! —Look who's talking, you're lookin' 
in top shape yourself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you. ...I have truly been 
looking forward to running with you in 
this race today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The raging fire within my heart that you 
reignited once more. With deepest 
gratitude, I will unleash it all against 
you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To my dearest "formidable foe," and one of 
my greatest "rivals"... Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooooohh!! Th-That's so fired up, isn't 
it?! Yaeno, you're the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Um, me too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The passion to chase after my idol that 
Bamboo-san believed in...! I'll show it to 
you in my running today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To one of my precious "rivals," Bamboo 
Memory!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O~~!!! Th-This makes me so happy, 
I could cry~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well, well!! Looks like everyone 
everywhere is fired up with festival 
fever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Inari-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, she's been getting almost as much 
attention as Oguri-senpai—a cool, 
true-blue Edo-style senior with an 
insanely powerful running style...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"You had quite the flashy clash with Oguri 
in the Yasuda Kinen, didn't ya? ...Still, 
are you sure about this?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Today's 2200m is my stage. It's a whole 
different story from the Yasuda Kinen, 
Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...True, it might not be my turf, so to 
speak. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of getting cold feet 
or using that as an excuse, not one bit!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm burning red-hot right now! And I'm 
gonna hit Inari-senpai with everything 
I've got, too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! Bring it on! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, let's let our running do the 
talking from here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then we're off as well. ...Let's make this 
the best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san! I'm not gonna lose, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on both of you!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaargh!! No way, no way, no way! My 
whole body won't stop tingling~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“—Why mention that now? It's been like 
that since yesterday, hasn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: City!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(She does her modeling jobs perfectly 
while captivating everyone with her sheer 
passion on the track—a super-stoic and 
cool Umamusume...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(And to me, she's a junior who's spent a 
long time sharing a dorm room with me...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looked like you guys were having a grand 
old time, but today's a huge race for me 
too. Mind not leaving me out?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! I never intended to leave you out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course I've been looking forward to 
running like this with City too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, even if you're crying in 
your room because I won, I'm not consoling 
you today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? I'm not gonna cry, and it's not 
like you've ever cheered me up before!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking, Senpai! Please don't 
go sulking over a loss and doing secret 
training in your room, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Today, I'm going all-out for the win more 
seriously than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! Let's go—with everything 
we've got!!
